text: {"lessons":["I should not let reluctance to admit a bad purchase keep me holding a stock; reassess each position using its prospects from today, not its purchase price.","I should judge every buy, hold, or sell against the same forward-looking standard instead of treating each stock as a separate account.","Checking prices often can tempt me into unnecessary action; I should trade only when my plan or portfolio needs change, not just because I feel pressure to act."]}
